changes: District IT administrators can manage, create, test and disable webhooks through the browser API bridge, matching server authorization.
Incomplete or oversized webhook receiver responses are no longer misclassified as successful deliveries.
Webhook retry-attempt input is bounded to 1–5 attempts and falls back safely for invalid values.
Webhook integration tests cover IT-admin parity and truncated response handling.
remainingRisks: Webhook dispatch is currently in-process and best-effort after the event write; a process crash between event persistence and dispatch can still lose a delivery. A durable cross-district outbox/worker is a separate required production milestone.
No live receiver, live PostgreSQL/RLS, multi-instance concurrency, external DNS rebinding, or production deployment test was performed.
